title: Air Fryer Soy-Ginger Shishito Peppers
description: Air-fried shishito peppers make for a quick and tasty appetizer, especially when tossed with soy sauce, lime, honey, and ginger.

steps.text: Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (199 degrees C).
Toss peppers with oil in a medium bowl to coat. Place peppers in the air fryer basket. Cook until blistered and tender, shaking basket halfway through, 6 to 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine soy sauce, lime juice, honey, and ginger in the same medium bowl. Add cooked peppers and toss to coat. Serve warm.

video.description: In this video, Nicole shows you how to make salted air fryer soy-ginger shishito peppers in under ten minutes. This tasty and surprisingly spicy snack recipe starts by tossing the peppers in olive oil. After they’ve been tossed, crisp and bake them in an air fryer for around seven minutes. Once the peppers have finished, coat them in a soy sauce and fresh ginger mixture to give them a sweet and savory flavor.
